en.t: She said that the man lived in the port city.

units.source_text: 因为把她安顿在那里不太方便，趁师傅来这个村子时就顺便将他带来的。

en.t: Since it was not very convenient to settle her there, he had been brought along when her master came to this village.

units.source_text: 人倒很亲切，可她从来未曾想过把自己许配给他，这事太可悲了。

en.t: He was certainly kind, but she had never once thought of promising herself to him, and that was too sad.

units.source_text: 由于年龄相差很大，他只是偶尔来一趟。

en.t: Because there was such a great difference in their ages, he only came by once in a while.
